subject: Access to proposal template on melange site

messages.author: 58d4347d38332c5c
messages.subject: Access to proposal template on melange site
parts:
Hello all,

I have a question related to submitting a proposal on the melange site. When I go to "My Dashboard" -> "Proposals", I do not see a place where I can submit the proposal (see attached). However, under FAQ it says: 

"If the organization you want to work with has a specific proposal template they would like you to use, it will be made available to you to fill in when submitting your proposal via the Google Summer of Code site."

I have already filled out the proposal template, but how do I access the template on the melange site?

Thanks,

Carson Sievert

messages.author: fc918931896c4405
messages.subject: Re: Access to proposal template on melange site
parts:
You need to go to http://www.google-melange.com/gsoc/homepage/google/gsoc2014 and press submit proposal. 
Only then you will be able to see your proposal at "My Dashboard" -> "Proposals".

Roman

Hi Carson,

You may go to the home page while you are logged in on the melange site. You'll see a "submit proposal" button there.
Best of Luck !
Please share your proposal here.

Thanks,
Shubham
